_comment: Hand-curated layer of docs/capabilities.json. The emitter (stapel_courses/_capabilities.py) merges this over the derived axes; an axis in conf.py DEFAULTS marked as an axis but missing here (or vice versa) is a loud emission error. surface_roots + surface are the usage layer: every public function of the selected modules carries an intent line here.
provides: Courses for a Stapel education product: Course -> Module -> Lesson (ordered, typed content blocks: text, video and attachments by opaque media id, embeds), enrollment with a lifecycle (pending, active, completed, expired, cancelled), a source (free, purchase, entitlement, staff grant) and an optional expiry, and an access gate per course chosen from a strategy registry (free, enrolled, purchased through stapel-orders, entitlement through stapel-billing). The outline names a lock reason for every lesson (sign in, enroll, buy, plan, drip date, previous lesson). Lesson progress is an idempotent upsert with a per-enrollment progress cache; drip by days since enrollment or by fixed date and a sequential-unlock switch pace a course. Quizzes on a lesson or module (single and multiple choice, true/false, short text) are graded on the server with attempt limits, a pass mark and a stored shuffle seed; answers never leave before submission. Completing every required lesson and quiz completes the course and issues a certificate with a public verification endpoint. A course is sold as orders purchasable type 'course' (resolver Function courses.purchasables); the order facts activate and cancel the enrollment. Courses never imports orders or billing.

requires.reason: comm bus (courses.* emits, purchasable/status/verify Functions, orders and user.merged consumers), AnchorPagination, GDPR owner protocol, AppSettings, swappable presenters
learners are request.user; a guest is a stapel-auth anonymous account, and user.merged moves a guest's enrollments, progress, attempts and certificates to the account on sign-in
sells courses: register purchasable type 'course' with resolver courses.purchasables (stapel_courses.preset.SETTINGS_DEFAULTS); orders.order.placed/paid/status_changed activate and cancel enrollments
answers billing.check_entitlement for courses with the 'entitlement' access mode (a plan includes the course)
resolves the opaque media ids of cover images, video and attachment blocks (the frontend asks it; courses never does)
profiles.public_cards (CARDS_FUNCTION) names the learner on the author/staff enrollment, review and certificate lists; absent, those lists show user_id only

extension_points.name: ACCESS_STRATEGIES
extension_points.summary: Access gate strategies by name, merged over free / enrolled / purchased / entitlement; a dotted path under a built-in name replaces it, None removes it. A strategy answers whether a learner may enroll themself (and with which source) and whether they see the content (with a lock reason).

extension_points.name: BLOCK_TYPES
extension_points.summary: Lesson content block validators by type, merged over text / video / attachment / embed. A validator takes the raw block dict and returns the cleaned dict to store or raises BlockInvalid.

extension_points.name: COMPLETION_RULE
extension_points.summary: Dotted path (enrollment) -> bool deciding completion after a lesson completion or a quiz pass; default: every required lesson completed and every required quiz passed.

extension_points.name: HOLDER_NAME_RESOLVER
extension_points.summary: Dotted path (user_id) -> str: the name printed on a certificate (default: the user's full name, else empty).

extension_points.name: STAPEL_COURSES_COURSE_PRESENTER / _ENROLLMENT_ / _LESSON_ / _QUIZ_ / _ATTEMPT_ / _CERTIFICATE_PRESENTER
extension_points.summary: Swap keys (STAPEL_SWAP) for the learner API presenters, so a host changes what the API shows without forking a view.

extension_points.name: courses.purchasables
extension_points.summary: The orders purchasable resolver for type 'course': {keys: [course id]} -> {id: {title, price, currency, available, max_quantity: 1, seller_id, image, url}}.

extension_points.name: courses.enrollment.activated
extension_points.summary: A learner gained access (self-enrollment, entitlement, paid order, staff grant): enrollment, course, user, source, order, expiry.

extension_points.name: courses.course.completed
extension_points.summary: A learner met the completion rule; emitted once per enrollment.

extension_points.name: courses.certificate.issued
extension_points.summary: A certificate record was issued; its number is the public verification key.

extension_points.name: orders.order.placed
extension_points.summary: Consumed: course lines open a pending enrollment for the buyer; orders.order.paid (or .status_changed to confirmed, per PURCHASE_ACTIVATION) activates it; cancelled/refunded cancels the enrollment that order granted.

DEFAULT_ACCESS.business_label: Who can open a new course
DEFAULT_ACCESS.summary: The access mode a new course starts with (each course can change it). free: anyone reads the lessons. enrolled (default): learners enroll for free, then read. purchased: learners buy the course through the shop first. entitlement: a paid plan includes it. Values: free, enrolled, purchased, entitlement.
DEFAULT_ACCESS.behavior: Sets Course.access on creation; the strategy decides POST enroll/ (purchased refuses with error.403.course_purchase_required) and gates lesson content with a lock reason.

ENROLLMENT_REQUIRES_ACCOUNT.summary: true (default): a guest must sign in to enroll, save progress or take a quiz. false: guests can, and their progress moves to the account when they sign in. Values: true, false.
ENROLLMENT_REQUIRES_ACCOUNT.behavior: true: enroll/progress/attempt endpoints answer error.403.enrollment_requires_account to a guest session; false: guests are treated like learners.

PURCHASE_ACTIVATION.summary: paid (default): when the order is paid. confirmed: also when staff confirm an order by hand (shops without online payment). placed: as soon as the order is placed. Values: paid, confirmed, placed.
PURCHASE_ACTIVATION.behavior: Selects which orders fact moves a purchase enrollment from pending to active; a cancelled or refunded order always cancels it.

DEFAULT_DRIP.summary: How a new course releases lessons. none (default): all at once. days: each lesson opens N days after the learner enrolls. date: each lesson opens on a fixed date. Values: none, days, date.
DEFAULT_DRIP.behavior: Sets Course.drip on creation; a lesson not yet released is locked with reason drip and its unlocks_at.

DEFAULT_SEQUENTIAL.summary: false (default): learners open lessons in any order. true: a lesson opens only after every earlier required lesson is completed and its required quizzes are passed. Values: true, false.
DEFAULT_SEQUENTIAL.behavior: Sets Course.sequential on creation; a blocked lesson is locked with reason sequential and the lesson or quiz to finish first.

AUTHORING.summary: staff (default): only staff create courses. members: any signed-in member creates and edits their own courses (a marketplace of teachers). Values: staff, members.
AUTHORING.behavior: staff: POST author/courses/ answers error.403.course_authoring_forbidden to non-staff; members: any non-guest account creates courses it then authors.

CERTIFICATES.summary: true (default): completing a course issues a certificate with a public verification page. false: no certificates. Values: true, false.
CERTIFICATES.behavior: true: completion issues a Certificate once and emits courses.certificate.issued; false: completion is recorded without a certificate.

strategy_paths.intent: The effective access strategy registry (built-ins <- ACCESS_STRATEGIES), name -> dotted path.

strategy_names.intent: The access names a course may carry; the author API refuses others with error.400.course_access_unknown.

get_strategy.intent: The strategy instance for a name; an unknown name gates like 'enrolled' (fail closed).

block_type_paths.intent: The effective block type registry (built-ins <- BLOCK_TYPES), type -> validator dotted path.

validator.intent: The validator callable of a block type, or None when the type is not registered.

clean_blocks.intent: Validate a lesson's blocks list with the registry; raises BlockInvalid carrying the index and a machine reason. Use it instead of storing author JSON unchecked.

text_block.intent: Built-in validator of a text block (text, format markdown|plain).

video_block.intent: Built-in validator of a video block (opaque media_id, caption).

attachment_block.intent: Built-in validator of an attachment block (opaque media_id, file name).

embed_block.intent: Built-in validator of an embed block (https URL, host in EMBED_HOSTS when set).
